nodes.label: Admin-only Category Creation
nodes.rationale: The category endpoint is admin-only, so accountants may see a clear permission error when creating a category inline.

nodes.label: Phase-based Implementation
nodes.rationale: Each phase is implemented in a separate commit and can be independently rolled back or skipped.

nodes.label: Native HTML5 Drag and Drop
nodes.rationale: The plan chooses native drag-and-drop because the frontend has no DnD library and should add no new dependency.

nodes.label: Role-gated Navigation Reordering
nodes.rationale: Only Admin and Accountant users can edit navigation order; Viewers can see the merged order but cannot reorder.

nodes.label: Optional Descriptive Budget Fields
nodes.rationale: Budget columns are retained as optional descriptive fields while validation, enforcement, warnings, and overspend limits are removed.

nodes.label: Phone-first Mobile Layer
nodes.rationale: The mobile layer has its own information architecture and capture flow optimized for one-handed use while leaving the desktop app untouched.

nodes.rationale: The design defers SPF/DKIM/DMARC and custom-domain work because this effort focuses on code-level deliverability and opt-out behavior.
